title: Docs reference page
description: Documentation page: left sidebar of sections, main column with headings, paragraphs, a callout and a diagram frame, right table of contents. For docs, references, guides, changelogs, knowledge bases.

title: Docs product landing
description: Landing page for a documentation or developer product: dark hero with a search box, quickstart panel, feature trio, dark feature sections with code, footer. For dev tools that sell on docs.

title: Dev tool landing
description: Dark, dense product landing for engineering software: wordmark nav, big headline hero with a product mock, logo row, statement, feature trio, alternating split sections, changelog, CTA, footer.

title: Design tool landing
description: Light product landing for a creative or design app: editor window mock in the hero, feature grid with art frames, roadmap list, testimonials, footer. For design, video, creative or productivity apps.

title: Corporate finance landing
description: Enterprise finance landing: hero with card mock, stats row, feature blocks with screenshots, customer quotes, pricing CTA. For B2B finance, expense, banking, accounting, insurance, corporate SaaS.

title: Protocol landing
description: Landing for a protocol or infrastructure product: hero, metrics strip, three pillars, integration logos as text, developer CTA. For crypto, DeFi, infrastructure, APIs, networks.

title: Platform landing
description: Bold platform landing: full width hero statement, builder sections, ecosystem grid, big type. For blockchains, platforms, developer ecosystems, communities.

title: Mobile app landing
description: Consumer mobile app landing: phone mock in the hero, feature sections each with a phone screen, download CTA, playful type. For any consumer app: fitness, health, finance, social, travel.

title: Startup app landing
description: Startup product landing: hero with app screenshot, three step how it works, feature cards, testimonials, pricing, FAQ, CTA. For SaaS and app startups of any kind.

title: Data dashboard hero
description: Above the fold for a data product: dense table of live rows, filters, stats. For trading, markets, analytics, dashboards, monitoring, admin tools.

title: Single app screen
description: One mobile app screen inside a phone frame, cards and transaction list. For a single screen or feature demo rather than a whole site.

title: Developer platform landing
description: Light landing for a platform with an API: hero with terminal and code, integration grid, workflow sections, customer quotes, footer. For APIs, automation, agents, developer platforms.

title: Collaboration tool landing
description: Enterprise collaboration landing: hero with product canvas, use case tabs, template gallery, customer logos as text, security section. For team tools, whiteboards, project management.

title: Designer portfolio home
description: Freelance designer or small studio home page: three column layout, side nav, intro with headline and bio, career list with years, client list, testimonial card. For portfolios, freelancers, studios, agencies.

title: Designer portfolio about
description: About page of a designer or studio portfolio: photo collage, story paragraphs, values list, contact. For portfolio about pages, team pages, personal sites.

title: Designer portfolio pricing
description: Services and pricing page of a freelancer or studio: fixed price packages, retainer card, what is included lists, FAQ. For freelance pricing, service packages, consulting rates.

title: Designer portfolio projects
description: Projects page of a designer portfolio: case study rows with title, year, tag and a preview frame, plus a contact block. For work lists, case studies, project grids.

title: Personal portfolio
description: Long personal portfolio: name and role hero, about, selected work cards with previews, experience timeline, contact. For developers, designers, writers, photographers.

title: Typographic one pager
description: Single screen portfolio in giant type: name split across the screen, a few links, one line of copy, arrows to flip. For bold personal one pagers, artists, studios with one statement.

title: Sales SaaS landing
description: Long SaaS landing: hero with product screenshot, social proof, feature sections with screenshots, testimonials, pricing tiers, FAQ, CTA. For B2B SaaS, sales, marketing, HR, CRM tools.

title: Text first landing
description: Minimal one column landing with almost no images: manifesto style copy, a few links, quiet type. For manifestos, waitlists, small tools, studios that lead with words.

title: Library docs with charts
description: Documentation for a code library: sidebar of components, live chart examples, code blocks, props tables. For component libraries, SDKs, charting or UI kits.

title: SaaS landing
description: Mid length SaaS landing: hero, logo row, three features with illustrations, comparison, pricing, footer. For general software products, local businesses, services.

title: Presentation tool landing
description: Landing for a creative SaaS: hero with product frames, template gallery, feature trio, testimonials, CTA. For slides, docs, content and media tools.
